3.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
3.en: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].

4.en: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -

5.ar: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
5.en: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

6.ar: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
6.en: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

7.ar: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
7.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.

8.ar: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
8.en: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.

9.en: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

10.ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
10.en: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.

11.en: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

12.ar: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
12.en: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."

13.ar: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
13.en: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.

14.ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
14.en: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."

15.ar: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
15.en: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].

16.ar: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
16.en: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

17.ar: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
17.en: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,

18.ar: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
18.en: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"

19.ar: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
19.en: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.

20.ar: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
20.en: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.

21.en: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

22.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
22.en: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.

23.en: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

24.ar: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
24.en: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."

25.en: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

27.en: And comfort wherein they were amused.

28.en: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

29.ar: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
29.en: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

30.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
30.en: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

31.ar: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
31.en: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.

32.ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
32.en: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.

33.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
33.en: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.

35.ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
35.en: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

36.en: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

37.ar: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
37.en: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.

38.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
38.en: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

39.ar: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
39.en: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.

40.en: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

41.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
41.en: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -

42.ar: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
42.en: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

45.en: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

46.en: Like the boiling of scalding water.

47.en: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

48.ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
48.en: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."

49.en: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!

50.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
50.en: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."

51.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;

53.en: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.

54.en: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

55.en: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

56.ar: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
56.en: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

57.ar: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
57.en: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

58.en: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.

59.en: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
